commentary: With the Nifty breaking key 22,500 support on massive foreign institutional selling and market breadth collapsing to 34 (594 advances vs 2,789 declines), the general market is trapped in a confirmed intermediate correction. Stan Weinstein and William O'Neil established that three out of four equities inevitably succumb to the market tide. In a 'WEAK' market environment, aggressive long exposure is prohibited. True market leaders do emerge during corrections by exhibiting outstanding relative strength and explosive, accelerating earnings. While a few names exhibit textbook CANSLIM numbers, capital preservation mandates progressive exposure, waiting for market stabilization, and honoring rigid stop-loss discipline on every prospective setup.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: SEPA (Minervini) | CANSLIM (O'Neil) | Stage Analysis (Weinstein) | Darvas Box & Livermore Discipline

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Price traces a 26.6% deep double-bottom base with a 6.5% handle above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with RSI at 55. However, microcap liquidity and lack of institutional volume accumulation make this technical structure prone to failure in a weak market tape.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severe operational contraction with Q1 FY27 sales dropping 56.3% and net profit tumbling 25.6% YoY. A subpar 3-year ROE of 3.13%, thin margins, and persistent promoter divestment disqualify the company entirely under O'Neil's CANSLIM criteria.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: A breakdown below the 95.95 handle low invalidates the base; illiquidity demands instant risk containment.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Textbook Stage 2 continuation breakout, clearing 20-session resistance to mark fresh 52-week highs. Holding well above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with RSI at 66, displaying immense relative strength and Darvas-style volume accumulation while benchmark indices plunge.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Outstanding CANSLIM credentials with Q1 FY27 EPS surging 53.8% and revenue jumping 38.7% YoY. Operating margins expanded to 19.9% on CDMO and specialty caffeine scale. Pristine balance sheet with minimal debt-to-equity (0.09) supports strong institutional backing.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Break below the 869.10 pivot low invalidates the breakout; Minervini discipline mandates cutting losses instantly.

ABBOTINDIA.technical: Constructive Stage 2 consolidation hovering within 1.5% of its pivot on an impressive 2.52× volume expansion. Price commands position above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with RSI 69, reflecting strong institutional flight to defensive pharmaceutical quality.
ABBOTINDIA.fundamental: World-class compounder with zero debt, superior 44.8% ROCE, and EBITDA margins widening to 28.8%. Nevertheless, modest top-line growth (+4.3%) and sub-20% EPS expansion fail O'Neil's strict 25%/15% CANSLIM growth gate.
ABBOTINDIA.risk: Failure to hold the 27,710.37 pivot support signals distribution; exit ruthlessly to protect capital.

ACE.technical: Stage 2 advancing base forming a constructive double bottom challenging 1,269.27 neckline resistance. Strong alignment across rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 alongside an RSI of 72 and bullish MACD confirms persistent accumulation despite adverse market breadth.
ACE.fundamental: Dominant mobile crane player (>60% domestic share) benefiting from infrastructure capex with ROCE near 28%. Q1 revenue expanded 19.5% and EPS rebounded +22.3%, but Q4 FY26 earnings contraction (-6.5%) leaves the setup only partially qualified.
ACE.risk: Neckline rejection and violation of 1,190.33 swing low destroys the pattern; cut losses without hesitation.

ADANIPORTS.technical: Consolidating tightly within 1.5% of 20-session highs on 1.74× volume. The stock maintains structural integrity above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with RSI at 63, exhibiting commendable relative strength during broad market liquidation.
ADANIPORTS.fundamental: Strong infrastructure monopoly generating 60% EBITDA margins, bolstered by international port revenues jumping 80%. However, steady net profit growth of ~10% lags CANSLIM's 25% target, and 1.9x net debt-to-EBITDA limits high-velocity momentum status.
ADANIPORTS.risk: Sustained close below the 1,790.95 support shelf violates the setup, demanding prompt stop adherence.

AEROFLEX.technical: High-caliber Stage 2 double bottom; orderly pullback to the rising 21-EMA on declining volume followed by a strong bullish reclaim. Positioned decisively above rising SMA50 and SMA200 with powerful relative strength against the declining market.
AEROFLEX.fundamental: Sensational CANSLIM profile catalyzed by AI data center liquid cooling skid demand. Q1 revenue leaped 72.4% and EPS surged 158.2% YoY with EBITDA margins widening to 23%. Almost zero debt and ROCE exceeding 20% attract institutional accumulation.
AEROFLEX.risk: Violation of the 528.75 swing low invalidates the base; execute Minervini-style risk cut immediately.
